description: As a fleet manager, I want to archive decommissioned aircraft records so that they no longer appear in active fleet lists but remain accessible for historical reporting.

acs.text: Clicking the Archive button marks the aircraft record as archived in the system.
Archived aircraft do not appear in the active aircraft dropdown or the main fleet list.
An archived aircraft record can be restored using the Restore action.
Archived aircraft remain visible in the historical reports section with an 'Archived' badge.

out_of_scope: Bulk archiving of multiple aircraft at once is out of scope.
